fresh_transfer_missing.reason: The action-root inventory is strong, but ordinary combinations such as find out, figure out, look after, give up, carry on, set up and take care are not yet uniformly expressible as natural phrase units.

History, art, media, environment, society, technology and health are present, but plain words for science-as-a-field, geography, economy, politics-as-a-topic, literature and nature-study remain incomplete.

interpretation: Major Level 4 Band A broadens the system into cultural participation and general-knowledge discussion without introducing technical specialization.
The system now transfers strongly into high-school-level conversational topics.
The remaining frontier is mostly natural idiomatic combination and broader category naming, not foundational communication.
